import csv, hashlib, json, math
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "benchmark_tools/results/native_factorial_terminal_resources_20261009_v1"
report = json.loads((out / "report.json").read_text())
expected = {}
for ref in report["evidence"]:
    raw = Path(ref["path"]).read_bytes()
    assert len(raw) == ref["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == ref["sha256"]
    value = json.loads(raw)
    if value["schema"] == "native_factorial_reporting_snapshot_v1":
        baseline = value
    elif value["schema"] == "native_qfo_terminal_failure_reporting_v1":
        qfo = {row["index"]: row for row in value["rows"]}
    else:
        expected[value["index"]] = value
rows = report["rows"]
assert [row["index"] for row in rows] == list(range(13))
assert report["baseline_rows_preserved"] == baseline["rows"]
scopes = ["wall_seconds", "cpu_seconds", "peak_memory_bytes"]
for row in rows:
    index = row["index"]
    if index < 7:
        original = baseline["rows"][index]
        assert row["job_id"] == original["job_id"] and row["cell"] == original["cell"]
        assert {key: row[key] for key in scopes} == {key: original[key] for key in scopes}
    else:
        review = expected[index]
        assert row["job_id"] == review["job_id"] and row["cell"] == review["cell"]
        resources = review["resources"] or {key: None for key in scopes}
        assert {key: row[key] for key in scopes} == resources
        assert row["native_outcome"] == review["status"]
    if index >= 6:
        assert row["accuracy_admitted"] == qfo[index]["accuracy_admitted"]
        assert row["accuracy_status"] == qfo[index]["status"]
    assert row["new_timing_admission"] is False
    assert all(row[key] is None or math.isfinite(row[key]) for key in scopes)
with (out / "resources.tsv").open() as stream:
    table = list(csv.DictReader(stream, delimiter="\t"))
assert len(table) == 13
for left, right in zip(table, rows):
    assert all(left[key] == ("NA" if right[key] is None else str(right[key])) for key in left)
human = (out / "resources.md").read_text()
for row in rows:
    assert "| " + row["dataset"] + " | " + row["cell"] + " | " + str(row["job_id"]) + " |" in human
    for key in scopes:
        if row[key] is not None:
            value = row[key] / (2**30 if key == "peak_memory_bytes" else 1)
            assert f"{value:.4f}" in human
assert sum(row["wall_seconds"] is not None for row in rows) == 11
assert sum(row["accuracy_admitted"] for row in rows) == 10
assert rows[7]["wall_seconds"] is None and rows[7]["accuracy_admitted"]
assert rows[9]["wall_seconds"] is None and not rows[9]["accuracy_admitted"]
assert not rows[11]["accuracy_admitted"] and not rows[12]["accuracy_admitted"]
summary = dict(schema="native_factorial_terminal_resource_readback_v1", rows=13,
    direct_input_pins_checked=len(report["evidence"]), resource_vectors_checked=13,
    tsv_cells_checked=sum(len(row) for row in table), measured_rows=11,
    accuracy_admitted_rows=10, historical_baseline_preserved=True,
    raw_accounting_replayed=False, new_scientific_admission=False, publication_ready=False)
print(json.dumps(summary))
